youtube_short.title: The $43,500 Roth Loophole Nobody Told You
title_alternatives: The Mega Backdoor Roth Most Workers Miss
youtube_short.description: Most people think they've maxed their retirement contributions — 401k done, Roth IRA done, move on. But your 401k actually has a total annual limit of $69,000, not $23,000. That $46,000 gap is after-tax space you can convert directly to Roth, completely legally. It's called the Mega Backdoor Roth, and only 20% of employers offer it. If yours does and you're not using it, you could be leaving over $4 million in tax-free growth on the table. Open your plan documents today and search 'after-tax contributions' or 'in-plan Roth conversion.' #401k #RothIRA #MegaBackdoorRoth #personalfinance #investing #retirementplanning

hook_line: There's a $43,500 door in your 401k nobody told you about
